requirements.SC-001: Resolve protected validator capability and existing subject-bound authority before requesting human review; availability alone never grants authority.
requirements.SC-002: Dispatch independent validation only for a current frozen subject with successful trusted checks; pending checks wait, failing checks enter bounded repair.
requirements.SC-003: Reconcile already merged subjects from exact external approval, merge and readback evidence without a second review or merge.
requirements.SC-004: Use a durable publication key binding repository, pull request, head and base; concurrent callers reconcile a single claim.
requirements.SC-005: Do not invoke an LLM again solely because polling timestamps, counters or narration changed; reassess on semantic change, a due bounded follow-up or periodic review.
requirements.SC-006: Measure progress through accepted state transitions and independently verified effects, not healthy services, plans, cycle counts or command exit status.
requirements.SC-007: Present goal, subject, operation, actor, reason, time and evidence references when recorded; explicitly mark unknown and truncated data and keep historical plans separate from recent activity.
requirements.SC-008: Adoption requires an exact published standard revision and digest, executable validation and runtime evidence for effect-capable consumers; static adoption never proves runtime execution.
